description.en: The file systems that you want to mount.

description.zh: 附加挂载文件系统的队列名称。
description.en: The queue name of the file system to be mounted.

description.zh: 附加挂载文件系统的本地挂载目录。
description.en: The on-premises mount directory of the file system to be mounted.

description.zh:
附加挂载的文件系统的存储位置。可能值：
- OnPremise：混合云集群。
- PublicCloud：公有云集群。
description.en:
The storage location of the file system to be mounted. Valid values:

*   OnPremise: The file system is stored in a hybrid cloud.
*   PublicCloud: The file system cluster is stored in a public cloud.

description.zh: 附加挂载的文件系统需要挂载的远程目录。
description.en: The remote directory to which the file system is mounted.

description.zh: 挂载文件系统的节点信息列表。
description.en: The array of the nodes to which the file system is mounted.
The ID of the file system to be mounted.

description.zh: 附加挂载的文件系统的存储挂载选项。
description.en: The mount option of the file system to be mounted.

description.zh: 附加挂载的文件系统挂载点地址。
description.en: The endpoint of the mount target of the file system.

description.zh:
附加挂载的文件系统协议类型。取值范围：
- NFS
- SMB
description.en:
The protocol type of the file system to be mounted. Valid values:

*   NFS
*   SMB

description.zh: 附加挂载的文件系统类型，目前仅支持NAS。
description.en: The type of the file system to be mounted. Set the value to NAS.

title.zh: 为指定集群挂载新的存储资源

example.legacyCli: aliyun ehpc UpdateClusterVolumes --region cn-hangzhou --AdditionalVolumes.1.VolumeMountOption '-t_nfs_-o_vers=3,nolock,noresvport' --ClusterId 'ehpc-hz-FYUr320000' --AdditionalVolumes.1.LocalDirectory '/ff' --AdditionalVolumes.1.VolumeMountpoint '00880000-sihc.cn-hangzhou.extreme.nas.aliyuncs.com' --AdditionalVolumes.1.Location PublicCloud --AdditionalVolumes.1.VolumeId 'extreme-00b880000' --AdditionalVolumes.1.VolumeProtocol NFS --AdditionalVolumes.1.RemoteDirectory '/test' --AdditionalVolumes.1.Roles.1 Compute --AdditionalVolumes.1.JobQueue work --AdditionalVolumes.1.VolumeType NAS
